notes: v537 — 🎯 Best Evidence Today, a new report at the TOP of Instant Reports — and the one this app has been building toward all along. It answers the buying question directly: of everything that fired TODAY, which shares carry the best graded evidence? Only lines holding a PROMISING or SOLID badge with a positive market-beating edge qualify — warnings, down-day flags and unproven lines never appear. Shares are ranked by the strength of the best line they fired (combinations rank highest, because agreement between flags is where the edge lives), each row showing the tier, edge, fire count, the three-year durability marks and the trajectory. Same maths as the 📋 report card, so the two can never disagree. And when nothing proven fired — it says so plainly, because an empty day is normal and honest. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
